searchText: will “latest” be a alias for “safe” post-paris? no it is still the latest block correct, and I'm drafting an update to that blog post literally right now given the confusion about `safe` does anyone have any opinions on the usage of protobufs/grpc for internal services communication in akula/erigon? vs doing something custom w/o codegen I have lots of weak opinions. If the expectation is that the services will usually be on the same network, so bandwidth doesn't really matter, then something human readable has value for debugging. People often underestimate the amount of time spent debugging things (both developers and users). Using preexisting tooling is also incredibly valuable. In general, if you are going to be doing some kind of serialization, I tend to recommend something standard. That being said, if the protocol is very simple, something like protobuf/grpc is likely way overkill and it kinda sucks requiring people integrate large SDKs just to serialize some numbers. Even though I truly hate protobufs and grpc in prysm, I'm sure Preston would make a pretty strong case for them
